product identity, not a variation. For example, "Milka Oreo" always has vanilla
cream filling — mentioning or omitting it does not make it a different product.
Focus on what makes products genuinely different: size, fat%, or clearly distinct
- Minor description variations that refer to the same base product
Every product must appear in exactly one group.
